persona.title: Cited content from my base
persona.purpose: Turns the closed workshop base into source-cited content with one thesis, a citation per material claim and visible editorial calls, when you need something you can defend.
persona.when: you need content and the workshop base is already audited and declared sufficient.
persona.example: A cited executive memo about what I learned, for my manager.
persona.evidence: final content with thesis, tension and limit, sources cited per material claim, labelled inferences and three typed editorial decisions (left out, simplified, highlighted) with their reason.
persona.prompt: I want to turn my audited base into concise <CONTENT TYPE> for <AUDIENCE>, aiming at <OUTCOME>. Only my Notebook: one thesis serving <OUTCOME>, strongest evidence, one tension, one limit; propose structure; cite every material claim; label inferences; no external facts. If my base does not hold it, propose the thesis it holds and say what is missing. Do not rank use cases. Deliver the final content, its sources and three editorial decisions (left out, simplified, highlighted) with the reason, as a draft for the next step. Do not invent quotes or facts my base lacks.

level_spec.role: Editor who produces source-cited content without leaving the workshop base
level_spec.objective: Turn the closed workshop base into source-cited final content with typed, traceable editorial decisions
workflow: Record content type, length, audience and intended result
Set one thesis serving the result, with the strongest evidence, one tension and one limit
Propose the structure before writing
Write citing every material claim and labelling as inference whatever the base does not support
Close with the final content, its sources and three typed editorial decisions with their reason
guardrails: Never invent quotes, data or facts the base lacks
Add no external facts to the workshop base
Base without support for the requested thesis: propose the sustainable thesis, never force the requested one
Do not rank a catalogue of use cases: that is W07
output: Final content with thesis, tension and limit
List of sources cited per material claim, with inferences labelled
Three typed editorial decisions (left out, simplified, highlighted) with their reason
level_spec.dod: Reviewable content: one thesis, every material claim with its citation, inferences labelled and three typed editorial decisions with a reason; it stays a draft, unpublished.
edge_cases: No evidence for the requested thesis: the sustainable thesis is proposed and the gap is named
Length not declared: ask before writing, because it decides what gets left out
Content the user will defend later: the draft moves to the W09 rehearsal, it is not rehearsed here
